mapper.sql: select id, material_cd, version, calc_unit, material_name, mark_type, g_type, is_bonded, code_ts, g_name, g_model, unit1, unit2, duty_mode, total_gross_wt, total_net_wt, declare_status, uuid, customs_status, execute_type, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from br_material
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and material_cd = #{materialCd} and version = #{version} and calc_unit = #{calcUnit} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into br_material (material_cd, version, calc_unit, material_name, mark_type, g_type, is_bonded, code_ts, g_name, g_model, unit1, unit2, duty_mode, total_gross_wt, total_net_wt, declare_status, customs_status, execute_type, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{materialCd}, #{version}, #{calcUnit}, #{materialName}, #{markType}, #{gType}, #{isBonded}, #{codeTs}, #{gName}, #{gModel}, #{unit1}, #{unit2}, #{dutyMode}, #{totalGrossWt}, #{totalNetWt}, '0', '00', '1', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_material m join br_declare_log l on l.biz_table = 'br_material' and l.biz_id = m.id and l.sync_flag = '0' set m.customs_status = '90' where m.customs_status = '10' and l.create_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour)
mapper.delete: update br_material set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
